wayricad.name: WayriCAD
wayricad.summary: Portable exports now recheck saved sources before publishing, while retaining the electrothermal and fabrication-review tools.
changes: Portable Web Export rejects stale component metadata and rechecks saved PCB, schematic and supported-model hashes before publishing an export.
Original-source hashes and exact embedded-byte hashes remain separate, including model-path transformations.
The suite retains shared steady rectilinear 3D electrothermal studies, primary-winding thermal feedback and imported fabrication-net short/open comparisons from 4.8.3.
wayricad.note: Export checks describe saved snapshots, not unsaved editor state or an operating-system file lock. Electrothermal and fabrication model limits remain in force.

spike.name: SPIKE
spike.summary: A clearer power-tree overview and a Geometry → basic PI handoff to the existing PCB resistive-network solver.
changes: Power-tree branches have direction, collapse, fit and zoom, with selection and evidence details. Inferred electrical paths still need review.
Geometry → basic PI passes normalized PCB copper to the existing routed DC solver and returns geometry-linked fields; it does not infer electrical properties from arbitrary STEP solids.
Saved thermal studies reopen in thermal setup. Workspace search, board-net controls and axis rotation rings have been refined.
spike.note: This source-only hotfix adds no installer or numerical kernel. Numerical review remains incomplete and the full Python suite does not pass; use the release record for the exact limits.

kicad_online.name: KiCad Online
kicad_online.summary: Refined saved drawing text, shared project navigation and multilayer inspection.
changes: Saved text variables, embedded symbol overrides, graphics and sheet markers follow the drawing source.
Project navigation, linked inspection, internal copper selection and reversible expanded assemblies share the refreshed viewer controls.
KERO is the public demonstration project; missing models and unsupported geometry stay disclosed.
kicad_online.note: GitHub artifacts are available. Android 1.100 is development-signed and GitHub-only; no Google Play or physical-phone acceptance is claimed. Native visual-review CI required a retry after an upstream KiCad PPA outage; package/release CI passed.

distribution.chrome: 0.12.101 published; 0.12.102 pending review with automatic publication

webview.name: KiCad WebView
webview.summary: Photoreal Fast, smooth Expand mode, compact controls and full-net layer colors with gold vias.
changes: Fast PBR studio rendering without a visible floor; no Node.js server is required.
Models lift, copper layers separate, substrate fades and through vias stretch while saved cross-selection remains intact.
Copper clicks highlight complete saved nets by default in their layer colors, with gold plated vias and an explicit scope indicator.
Compact ribbon and inset controls, native schematic text placement and bounded large-project loading and late-part inspection.
webview.note: Read-only visualization; missing models and rendering approximations remain disclosed. Large-project acceptance ceilings do not qualify maximum-size 3D rendering, physical-phone speed or solver accuracy. Other products retain separately pinned WebView versions.
